caption: The drawing features a composition of abstract floral and leaf patterns spreading outward from a central point on a plain, off-white background. The central motif consists of a multicolored flower-like shape with petals in green, dark blue, yellow, and magenta, and a round pale yellow center. Surrounding this are four large, scalloped, leaf-like forms rendered in shades of brown, pink, magenta, and cream, each outlined and detailed with colored lines. Several stems radiate from the central composition, each adorned with teardrop-shaped leaves colored in yellow, blue, brown, and magenta. Smaller, stylized six-petaled flowers in dark blue and pink with a white center, as well as additional abstract leaf shapes, are attached to these extending stems. The overall color palette includes varying shades of pink, magenta, blue, green, yellow, brown, and cream. At the lower right, text is handwritten in red ink. The composition is balanced mostly to the left side of the page, with more empty space on the right and bottom edges.
title: Colcha Plate
